name: OPC UA
description: Browse the OPC UA address space of PLCs and servers, then read and write node values with data type aware decoding.
releaseNotes: 0.2.0: new plugin and connection icons; three-column workbench with draggable splitters; Variable points can be dragged onto the board; writes resolve the node DataType server-side, report the OPC UA status code on failure and read the value back.
